VBO:0200870.summary: Affectionate and eager to please, two-year-old Racket illustrates one keeper’s account of a Mastweiler. Her owner described an alert dog who guarded when voices rose angrily, yet enjoyed rough play with their English Bull Terrier. Racket came from a multigeneration programme based largely on English Mastiffs and Rottweilers, with a reported distant Neapolitan Mastiff ancestor whose exact place in the pedigree was uncertain.
VBO:0200870.shortDescription: A Mastiff–Rottweiler cross; Prince’s owner described camping and river trips, while Racket’s noted eager affection.
